lines.en: I walk the seabed, my step light.
I drag my long robe, and the water pushes it.
I swim toward the altar.
I go around a sunken pillar.
I retreat slowly, facing you.

lines.zh: 我走一步，手指在水里划。
lines.en: Each step, my fingers trail the water.
I swim in the dark, silent.
I come out from behind the coral.

lines.zh: 我的长袍缠了一下，我拉平。
lines.en: My robe tangled; I smooth it.
I walk along the ruin's wall.
I swim a little toward you, then back.
I raise my head at the light above.

lines.zh: 我从遗迹的拱门下穿过。
lines.en: I pass under the ruin's arch.

lines.zh: 我在沙上留下一串脚迹。
lines.en: I leave a line of prints in the sand.

lines.zh: 我把手贴在石墙上，摸过去。
lines.en: I slide a hand along the stone wall.
I slowly circle past your flank.

lines.zh: 我在祭坛边站着，很安静。
lines.en: I stand by the altar, very quiet.
I hold a pearl in my hand.

lines.zh: 我的眼在珊瑚影里发光。
lines.en: My eyes glow in the coral's shade.
I listen to the water's vibration.
I count the patterns on the altar.
My robe drifts in the water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张开手，看看珍珠。
lines.en: I open my hand slowly to look at the pearl.

lines.zh: 我生来就在这层水底下。
lines.en: I was born beneath this layer of water.

lines.zh: 我在等一个带珍珠的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone carrying pearls.
My breathing goes with the current.
I raise my head; there's a shadow.
I tuck the pearl into my robe.

lines.zh: 我把袍角理了理，很旧了。
lines.en: I smooth my robe's hem; it's old.
I listen to the water in the altar.
You carry the smell of pearls.
I keep my distance; don't misread it.
Do you trade?
I'm wary of you; that's the way here.

lines.zh: 你的手脚在陆地上更灵活。
lines.en: Your limbs work better on land.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的指节，那里会动。
lines.en: I watch your knuckles; that's where it starts.
The ruin behind you is very old.
Don't come too close; I throw poorly up close.
You're the first to come down.
I remember the affairs of my people.
I pull back, a hand on the wound.
I cough up a little water.
Blood mixes into the water and slowly spreads.
I don't cry out; sound travels here.
I retreat behind the pillar.

lines.zh: 我往后缩，眼睛多了戒备。
lines.en: I shrink back, wariness creeping into my eyes.
I steady myself against the pillar.
I dropped a pearl.

lines.zh: 我抬手，示意你别再过来。
lines.en: I raise a hand: no closer.
I'm here, and I can still swim.
That pearl; good quality.
Set the pearl on the altar.

lines.zh: 珍珠在掌心，我不敢握紧。
lines.en: The pearl sits in my palm; I don't dare close my hand.
Give more, and goodwill rises.
I smell seawater.
I like that sheen.
Don't hold it too high.
I take one step toward the altar.
The pearl is like me.
I counted; you gave me three.
You come near, and I back away.
We collide, and the water scatters.

lines.zh: 我的手按在你盾上，很凉。
lines.en: My hand presses your shield, cold.
I turn and give half a block.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的袍角，我拉了拉。
lines.en: You step on my hem; I tug it free.
I'm knocked into a backward slide.
We're too close; I'm uneasy.
You reach out; I raise a hand.

lines.zh: 水流一推，我的肩撞上你。
lines.en: A push of current and my shoulder hits yours.
I pull back and keep my distance.

lines.zh: 另一个从祭坛后面出来。
lines.en: Another comes from behind the altar.
Her robe is a deeper color.
We stand side by side, watching the surface.

lines.zh: 她把一颗珍珠放进我手里。
lines.en: She places a pearl in my hand.

lines.zh: 我们一起数祭坛上的纹。
lines.en: We count the altar's patterns together.
Her eyes are brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这片遗迹。
lines.en: We keep this ruin together.
She speaks softly, like water.

lines.zh: 我们的袍子在水里缠在一起。
lines.en: Our robes tangle in the water.
Two of us, one altar.
I pick up a pearl and stow it.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的珍珠还给你。
lines.en: I return the pearl you dropped.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚贝壳，看了看。
lines.en: I pick up a shell and examine it.

lines.zh: 我把沉在土里的骨拾起来。
lines.en: I lift a bone from the silt.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块碎瓦，放回墙里。
lines.en: I pick up a shard and set it back in the wall.

lines.zh: 我把你的刀推回去给你。
lines.en: I push your knife back to you.
I pick up a snapped cord and coil it.
I pick up an old coin and toss it.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的珍珠吹干净。
lines.en: I blow the dust off the fallen pearl.
I lift a piece of coral; it's light.
You reached out; I back off first.

lines.zh: 你的手腕一沉，我看见了。
lines.en: Your wrist dips, and I see it.

lines.zh: 我绕到石柱背后，数着秒。
lines.en: I slip behind the stone pillar, counting the seconds.

lines.zh: 这一下不像是来交易的。
lines.en: This doesn't look like trade.

lines.zh: 我的手已经握住墨水弹。
lines.en: My hand is on an ink bomb.
I pull back from your front.
The people will remember this.
I know whom you've hurt.
Three counts and I throw.
This seabed belongs to us.
I hold this distance.
You come forward; I go back.
I rest a hand at my waist.
I move to the other side of the pillar.
Your lamp is bright underwater.
I'm gauging how fast you swim.
I retreat below the altar steps.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁，慢慢绕过去。
lines.en: I hug the stone wall and circle around.

lines.zh: 你换手提灯，我往暗处挪。
lines.en: You switch the lamp hand; I slide into the dark.
I raise a hand: one warning.
I throw an ink bomb.
The ink spreads and blinds you.
I shove you once.
That cut wasn't mine.
I retreat and throw again.

lines.zh: 我的手抓在你的手腕上。
lines.en: My hand grips your wrist.
I muddy the water; you can't see.
That was light; a warning.
I grab your lamp.
I press it against the altar's rim.

lines.zh: 我从柱子的阴影里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the pillar's shadow.
The light on the altar wavers.
The water is cold here; good.
I heard someone fall in above.
I turn slowly to face you.
The water lifts my robe.
I've lived in this ruin a long time.
Another one has come down.
I set the pearl on the altar.

lines.zh: 我看见光了，不是水面的。
lines.en: I see a light that isn't the surface's.

lines.zh: 水被烧热了一点，我往上浮。
lines.en: The water warms; I rise.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，撞在石上。
lines.en: I fall from the steps onto stone.

lines.zh: 我在水里也呛到了，很难受。
lines.en: Even here I choke on water; it's wretched.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水和石都掀起来。
lines.en: The blast throws water and stone.

lines.zh: 一支箭在水里慢下来，插在我肩上。
lines.en: An arrow slows in the water and sticks in my shoulder.
The light in the water pins me.
On this seabed even the shells are empty.

lines.zh: 电顺着水爬上我的袍子。
lines.en: Lightning crawls up the water and onto my robe.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，也没有祭坛。
lines.en: No water here, and no altar.
